geometry.relation: face centroid opposite vertex i equals -vertex_i/3 for a centered regular tetrahedron

summary.face_vortex_result: At every tested separation, the minimum-energy orientation places a triangular face toward T0, not an apex.
summary.vertex_control_result: At every tested separation, the minimum-energy orientation places one apex toward T0.

interpretation: The desired inverted-pyramid orientation is not a generic consequence of tetrahedral geometry plus attraction. It depends on where the inter-tetrahedron coupling is carried. Direct face-centroid coupling prefers face-inward, while vertex-carried coupling prefers apex-inward.
